text: Frozen and reran the exact current HalfFlow/BasinBridge sub-18 diagnostic baseline without modifying recipient controls. Manifest c69d61a... pins the 66-file HalfFlow tree 795cc836..., capability ledger, probe/config sources, six external artifact hashes, C0 metrics, matcher/CC/fine/topology/export controls, and non-promotional boundary. Raw log b6f8f5d... records a 221 s run. C0 and saved ANTs outputs reproduced at abs1e-6+rel1e-6. BasinBridge accepted 18 anchors, retained 15 after three support failures, improved match error 15.7558 to 8.7653 mm in 143682 ms, but its intermediate export was rejected: inverse residual 0.679645 mm >0.2, minimum sampled Jacobian -0.48909, 11434/1019825 nonpositive cells. The unchanged fine stage failed after 5029 ms at shrink 1 with AccumulatedJacobianTooSmall(Fixed,0.03943797), below the 0.05 floor. C4 is therefore an explicit invalid-geometry/fine-stage failure; bridge metrics are retained but not substituted. Receipt cfdf2132149de6f94dd02977b5cc92ab0f92c10f7b3a58fae8dd598735ed531a. HalfFlow remains unadmitted (0/20 checked-in anatomical pairs), no ANTs parity claim, and no dependency is imposed on standalone Flashalign linear release.
